title: Cancer
lyrics:
[00:12.72]Turn away
[00:16.79]If you could get me a drink
[00:20.42]Of water, 'cause my lips are chapped and faded
[00:24.61]Call my Aunt Marie
[00:29.46]Help her gather all my things
[00:33.20]And bury me in all my favorite colors
[00:38.02]My sisters and my brothers, still
[00:42.38]I will not kiss you
[00:50.38]'Cause the hardest part of this is leaving you
[01:03.61]Now turn away
[01:08.00]'Cause I'm awful just to see
[01:11.60]'Cause all my hair's abandoned all my body
[01:15.92]Oh, my agony
[01:20.72]Know that I will never marry
[01:24.80]Baby, I'm just soggy from the chemo
[01:29.22]But counting down the days to go
[01:33.62]It just ain't livin'
[01:37.20]And I just hope you know
[01:41.98]That if you say goodbye today (If you say goodbye today)
[01:48.36]I'd ask you to be true ('Cause I'd ask you to be true)
[01:54.37]'Cause the hardest part of this is leaving you
[02:07.18]'Cause the hardest part of this is leaving you
